evidence.notes: Packaged static resource names resolve against the local project namespace and CSV relationship columns such as Parent__r.External_Id__c expand to lookup IDs before DML.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeTestLoadDataFullLocalTest { @isTest static void rows() { Parent__c parent = new Parent__c(Name = 'Parent', External_Id__c = 'PARENT-1'); insert parent; List<Child__c> rows = Test.loadData(Child__c.SObjectType, 'pkg__Children'); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Child__c child = [SELECT Parent__c FROM Child__c LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals(parent.Id, child.Parent__c); try { Test.loadData(Child__c.SObjectType, 'other__Children'); System.assert(false, 'bad namespace should fail'); } catch (Exception e) { System.assert(e.getMessage().contains('namespace other does not match local package namespace pkg')); } } }
